text:
incident-bot: ALERT: High error rate detected for service api-gateway (prod-us-east). Symptom: sudden spike in 5xx and 429 responses starting ~4130000000. Paging oncall: @lia · P1

lia: on it, joining. saw alert flood to my phone. grabbing console.

sam: I’m looking at the gateway logs — 429s upstream from rate-limiter service, then proxy retries causing 502/504. looks like a quota misapply around 4130000000.

anya: can you confirm whether this is a config rollout? I saw a config PR merged ~4129999900 for rate-multiplier changes.

mike: that PR bumped default tenant_multiplier from 1 -> 10 for the new tenancy sharding test. It should have been scoped to feature flag but the selector missed prod.

lia: ok hypothesis: global quota multiplier accidentally applied, causing global RLS to hit limits -> 429 -> clients retry -> overload downstream -> 5xx.

maya: Support: customers are reporting degraded generation latency and some timeouts. I already flagged 3 enterprise customers in prod-us-east.

evan: traffic metrics: token throughput down 18%, error rate (5xx) up 14% across gateways, 429s up 120%. Most traffic coming from model-serving path /v1/generate.

sam: immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback config in control plane 2) patch rate-limiter to widen per-tenant cap 3) enable gateway retry-suppression/fail-open for 429s. Recommend quick rollback+fail-open.

lia: doing rollback of config now. running: 
```bash
kubectl -n control-plane set image deploy/rls config=control-plane:rollback-20240325
# or patch configmap
kubectl -n control-plane patch configmap rate-config -p '{"data":{"tenant_multiplier":"1"}}'
```

deploy-bot: deploy started by lia at 4130000065: control-plane configmap patch (patch-id: rls-fix-4130000065)

mike: patch looks good but we should also open temporary safeties: reduce retry budget in gateway to avoid retry storms.

sam: applying gateway retry-suppression patch: 
```yaml
# temp: suppress retries on 429s for 120s
route_match: /v1/*
retry_policy:
  retry_on: "5xx"
  max_retries: 0
  per_try_timeout_ms: 2000
  fail_open_on_429: true
```

sam: applied.

lia: control-plane patch finished at 4130000102, verifying.

evan: metrics: 5xx trending down after patch, 429s dropping but still elevated. latency stabilizing.

maya: notified accounts: Sent initial incident pings to affected accounts, will escalate to account owners with ETA 15m for full restore.

mike: we should also open a capacity burst: spin a dedicated pool to absorb remaining traffic while control-plane propagates. initiating scale: 
```bash
redwoodctl dedicated scale --pool ml-prod-east --replicas +3 --duration 30m
```

deploy-bot: dedicated scale request accepted (req-7342) at 4130000140

sam: seeing a gap — some requests still failing because of stale token-bucket caches on edge nodes. planning to trigger cache invalidation.

lia: invalidating edge caches now. command: 
```bash
for node in $(kubectl -n gateway get pods -l role=edge -o name); do kubectl exec $node -n gateway -- /usr/local/bin/edge-cache flush; done
```

lia: edge cache invalidation issued at 4130000205.

evan: edge-stats: token-bucket refill resumed, 429s down 67% from peak. 5xx near baseline.

mike: confirming root cause: PR incorrectly used global flag in config templating. will open hotfix PR to add stricter selectors and unit test.

anya: please include a post-deploy validation step to assert prod flagging isn't set. add a CI check.

lia: paging follow-up: I’ll stay on for another 30m and then hand off to sam. lia -> sam handoff ETA 4130000360.

sam: I'll take over after 4130000360. next actions: monitor for 1 hour, verify no customer regressions, coordinate postmortem.

maya: Customer impact: ~2% of generation requests affected for 6-12 minutes peak. 3 enterprise customers reported degraded experience — support has opened tickets and applied temporary credits.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation in place. status: degraded -> stabilizing. primary mitigation: control-plane config rollback + gateway retry suppression + edge cache invalidation + dedicated burst.

lia: quick notes for postmortem: timeline, PR id (PR#4321), bad templating change, missing scope selector, missing prod flag test, rollout detection gap. recommend gated config rollout for control-plane and canary propagation checks.

mike: creating follow-up issue and assigning to infra/config team.

sam: I'll draft incident summary and severity impact; will include runbook actions and assign hotfix PR review.

maya: I'll collect customer logs and compile account-level impact summary for 24h.

lia: handing off to sam now. summary for oncall: root cause = accidental global quota multiplier application -> cascade (429 -> retries -> 5xx). primary fix = rollback + retry-suppression. ongoing: monitor for recurrence, deploy templating guard.

sam: taking over. thanks @lia. ping me for anything. :thumbsup:
